headline: On October 31, 2000: Soyuz TM-31 launches to the ISS
captionCards: First long-duration crew to the ISS launched 2000
Continuous human presence on ISS since 2000
instagramCaption:
Soyuz TM-31 launched with the first long-duration ISS crew.
Soyuz TM-31, carrying the Expedition 1 crew, was launched from Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan at 07:52 UT on October 31, 2000. This marked the beginning of continuous human presence on the International Space Station. The mission was a significant milestone in space exploration, paving the way for international cooperation and scientific research in space. Why is this still important today? 🚀🌍
